overview: The committee reviewed the 2025 Citizen Control over Public Surveillance (CCOPS) annual report detailing the Medford Police Department's use of body-worn cameras and external surveillance data. The council discussed audit compliance, privacy protections, and the methodology for assessing community impacts.

items.title: 2025 Annual Surveillance Report
items.summary: Chief Jack Buckley presented the annual report, highlighting that the department recorded over 32,000 body-worn camera videos in 2025 and uses external data like facial recognition and GPS tracking for serious criminal investigations only. Councilors and residents questioned the department on internal audit procedures, policy for camera activation failures, and the methodology used to determine that no communities were disproportionately impacted by surveillance.

items.title: Report Approval and Adjournment
items.summary: Approved the report and kept the paper in committee.
